name: magnetic-prompt-suggestions
title: Magnetic Prompt Suggestions
description: A horizontal rail of suggestion cards with elastic magnetism. We track the pointer per-card, clamp the magnetic radius, and feed the dampened delta into spring x/y values. The icon and arrow ride a snappier spring so they 'lead' the card.
author: Wensity <hello@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-cabinet, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif)

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/magnetic-prompt-suggestions.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add magnetic-prompt-suggestions.
